evidence.locator: 2243 x 2511 px; Hubble ACS and WFC3, from 435 nm to 1.6 µm, the shortest wavelengths blue and the longest red. The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.05549 arcsec per pixel, north 7.3° right of vertical, the frame's centre at 342.185158802°, -44.5300561316°. Not measured against Gaia here; the same publishers' tags were within 0.4 arcsec on four cluster pictures and 1.5 arcsec off on one deep field.
